A '''synth-sapph''' was an inexpensive, artificial [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]].

[[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], while stealing the [[Ankarres Sapphire]] from [[Dom Pricina]], substituted a synth-sapph&mdash;with a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] embedded within&mdash;for the powerful healing jewel.
